A.name: Stack A: Sovereign Executive Orchestrator
A.tagline: Open WebUI is the command center, Qdrant stores long-term company memory, Temporal runs durable multi-day tasks, Langfuse audits every action.

B.name: Stack B: Visual Multi-Agent Teammate
B.tagline: Dify & AnythingLLM run visual knowledge agents, LiteLLM routes across local/cloud models with budget caps, NocoDB manages executive approval boards.

open-webui.name: Open WebUI
open-webui.role: Executive AI chat command center, private RAG docs & multi-model workspace
open-webui.first_run: No login required locally (WEBUI_AUTH=False). Auto-connects to local Ollama on host.docker.internal:11434.

qdrant.name: Qdrant Vector Memory
qdrant.role: High-speed semantic vector memory storing SOPs, transcripts & company knowledge
qdrant.first_run: Open /dashboard to inspect vector collections, semantic search indexes, and memory payloads.

temporal.name: Temporal Orchestrator
temporal.role: Durable long-running autonomous task & multi-step workflow execution engine
temporal.first_run: Temporal Server (:7233) + Temporal Web UI (:5720) boot automatically with zero manual DB setup.

langfuse.name: Langfuse Observability
langfuse.role: AI employee audit traces, prompt versioning, latency & token cost governance
langfuse.first_run: Create your local workspace account on first visit to inspect live agent traces and cost ledgers.

dify.name: Dify Agent Studio
dify.role: Visual AI teammate builder, tool-calling workflows & RAG knowledge pipelines
dify.first_run: Complete the 1-step admin setup at /install, then build or import autonomous agent workflows.

anythingllm.name: AnythingLLM
anythingllm.role: All-in-one private AI teammate with document RAG, web scraping & MCP agents
anythingllm.first_run: Follow the 30-second onboarding wizard to link Ollama or an API key and upload company SOPs.

litellm.name: LiteLLM Gateway
litellm.role: Unified OpenAI-compatible router across 100+ local & cloud LLMs with spend caps
litellm.first_run: Admin UI at /ui — log in with LITELLM_MASTER_KEY from tools/litellm/.env to manage model keys & budgets.

nocodb.name: NocoDB Executive Board
nocodb.role: Open-source Airtable alternative for AI task queues, SOPs & human approvals
nocodb.first_run: Sign up on first visit to create your local super-admin and executive task approval tables.
